name: New Heavenly Sword and Dragon Sabre
description: New Heavenly Sword and Dragon Sabre is a Hong Kong television series adapted from Louis Cha's novel The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber. The series was first broadcast on TVB Jade in Hong Kong in 1986.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview:
Impressed by the hearsay that "The martial worlds gem Dragon Sabre commands the world and none dares to disobey", the three "Animals" of Chang Pai braved everything to steal it from the Hai She clan. They thought they could from then on gain supremacy in the martial world, but are pursued, pelted with poison salt, and forced to hand it over.

The three are beaten. Wu Tang clan pupil Yu Tai-yen and Chang Tsui- shan rescue one of them, but are assaulted by Tien Ying's Yin Yeh-wang and Chang Chin-peng. In the melee, the three are killed and the sabre falls into the hands of Tsui Shan, who hands it over to his master Chang San-feng. ,

On the way, Tai-yen spots a squad of Mongol soldiers drafting able- bodied men much to the grief of their family. Indignant over the injustice done, he kills all the soldiers with the Dragon Sabre. He also uses it to break the chains for the Hans and is amazed at its unusual sharpness……

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview:
Tsui-shan sees Tai-yen in a critical condition and takes him to Wu Tang to seek his master's help. After diagnosis, San Feng suspects that Shaolin's Chin Kang Finger has broken his veins. Then memories of the past surge up

While a child, San Feng was sent to the Shaolin Temple to help Master Chio Yuan guard the classics. Playing around in the Temple, Kuo Shang struck an acquaintance with San Feng, and the two became good friends. Subsequently, Priest Wu Shih recognized Kuo Shang to be the daughter of Kuo Tsing, and extended warm hospitality to her.

The Saint of Kun Lun deliberately makes trouble in the Temple on the pretext of searching for the lost classic. On a flash of impulse, San Feng used Lo Han fists which he subconsciously learnt while drying the classics at the Sutra Chamber against them. They were bewildered by this……

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview:
Tsui-shan goes back to the Security Bureau and finds that all the people there were killed. Master Yuan Yin and Yuan Yeh accuse Tsui-shah of killing them.  Tsui-shan gets known with SU-su and finds she is injured by Shaolin disciples when she wants to save Tai-yen. She is angry and kills the Shaolin disciples and the people of the Security Bureau. Tsui-shan saves her and discovers she is the people of Tien Ying Clan.

Master Yuan Yin and Yuan Yeh say that the Wu Tang Clan shelters Tsui-shan. At last, it is settled by San-feng. Tsui-shan and Su-su attends the Wang Pan Shan Sabre Meeting. The clans begin to struggle for the Sabre.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview:
Golden Lion Shin Sun appears in the meeting. He washes out the people's memory by his Lion Roar and brings Tsui-shah and S1i-su away. Only Bai Kui-shou can escape from it. Kun Lun's He Tai-chong arrives and guesses Tsui-shan has got the Sabre.

Shih Sun wants to go to a deserted island to discover the secret of the Dragon Sabre so as to take revenge. He Tai-chong discovers the Sabre is taken away by Shih Sun and so joins with Kong Tong Clan to look for the whereabouts of Kui-show.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview:
The ship wrecks. Su-su blinds Shih Sun with a poisonous pin and escapes with Tsui-shan. Later, they meet Shih Sun who is wounded seriously. They save him. Shih Sun is moved and befriends with them. The clans force Tien Ying Clan to give them Kui-shou. Yen Tien-tsen asks him to pretend to be dead to prove his innocence.

Tsui-shan and Su-su fall in love with each other. Shih Sun acts as a go-between and they get married at last.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview:
Shih Sun is stimulated and becomes mad. He is afraid that he will inquire the son of Tsui-shan and Su-su and so avoids seeing them.

Years ago on the night when Shih Sun's son was a month old, Chen Kun, his teacher came to the feast. He raped Shih Sun's wife and killed his family members. Shih Sun wanted to take revenge. Master Kong Chian of shaolin was made use of by Chen Kun and was killed by Shih Sun.

Tsui-shan and Su-su are sympathetic with him and name their son as Wu-chi after Shih Sun's son.

Before the marriage of Yen Li-ting and Chi Hsiao-fu takes place, Abbess Mien Chieh ordered Hsiao-fu and Min-shun, her sister, to look for the whereabouts of the Dragon Sabre.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview:
Hsiao-fu separates with Min-chun and meets Yang Chiao. She is injured by the Yuan's soldiers and is saved by Yang Chiao. She stays at his home and is raped. She discovers that Yang Chiao is the Advisor of the Ming Clan and decides to go back to E Mei.

Since the Chief of Ming Clan has disappeared, the clan is disorganized. Yang Chiao wants to select another Chief but the four protectors disagree.

Hsiao-fu finds that she is pregnant. She goes down the mountain and gives birth to a daughter, called Yang Bu-hui.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview:
It has been nine or ten years. Tsui-shan and Su-su worries for the future of Wu-chi for it seems they can't go back to Chung Yuan. The disciples of Wu Tang are still looking for Tsui-shan.

From time to time, Hsiao-fu goes to see her daughter. Li-ting asks Abbess Mieh Chueh to decide the date of marriage. Hsiao-fu feels guilty and rejects his love.

Tsui-shan makes a raft so as to go back to Chung Yuan. Shih Sun forces them to go away. They are saved by some fishermen from the sea. Wu Chi is delighted with the novel life-style.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview:
Yin Yeh-wang loves his second wife and neglects his first wife and his daughter. Yin Li is so angry that she kills her auntie. His father chases Yin Li but she is saved by Madam Chin Rua.

Tsui-shan and Sh-su want to solve the problem and say that Shih Sun has been killed by them. However Wu-chi tells them the truth. The clans think that Wu Tang gangs with the Ming Clan to get the Dragon Sabre.

Yin Tien-tsen appreciates the righteousness of Tsui-shan and invites him to join Tien Ying Clan, but is refused.

On the other hand, Abbess Mieh Chueh also wants to look for Shih Sun to take revenge for his brother.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview:
Ku-chi is caught by He Bi-weng. He is such a brave boy that he does not disclose where Shih Sun is.

Tsui-shan and Su-su are saved by Tsang Song-hsi and Li-ting. Tsui-shan is sad to know Tai-yen has been a disable.

Three big Security Bureau go to Wu Tang to settle the feud for Lung Men Security Bureau. But it is solved by Tsang Song-hsi. On San-feng's hundredth birthday, Shaolin forces San-feng to give them Tsui-shan. Out of discontents, Song-hsi accuses them of injuring Tai-yeh.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview:
The Wu Tang disciples attack the master of Shaolin so as to avenge for Tai-yeh but they fail. When Tai-yeh sees Su-su, he recalls the past. Su-su admits she injured him. Tsui-shan is so ashamed that he kills himself. Bi-weng and Wu-chi arrive. Su-su killed herself too.

Wu-chi is seriously poisoned by the Mystic Palm. He can only be saved if he can practice the Piercing Sun Skill. San-feng only knows a part of the skill. Therefore, he begs Abbess Mieh Chueh and Master Kong Min to give him the other parts of it so as to save Wu-chi but is refused. At last, Kong Min lets Wu-chi stay in Shaolin. But then, a San-feng mistake Kong Min has some evil-intention and so leaves with Wu-chi.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview:
Chang Yu-chun protects his young master to escape to the south but involves a family. He then brings Chou Tzu-jo with him. He is injured and saved by San-feng. Yu-chun promises to bring Wu-chi to find Doctor Hu Chin-niu and asks San-feng to bring Tzu-jo up.

Chin Niu refuses to cure Wu-chi for he is not the follower of the Ming Clan. But at last, he promises. Under the guidance of Chin Niu, wu-chi cures Yu-chun.

Abbess Mieh Chueh asks Hsiao-fu and Min-chun to look for Kui-shou again. Li-ting waits for Hsiao-fu at the foot of the mountain and comes across Yang Chiao. When he knows Yang's relationship with Hisao-fu, he beats him madly.

Min-chun follows Hsiao-fu stealthily to see Bu-hui and understands all. They meet Kui-shou. Peng Ying-yueh comes to help him. Hsiao-fu does not want to kill Ying-yue. And Min-chun reports it to Abbess Mieh Chueh.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview:
Wu-chi has grown up and now knows some medical skill.

Chin Hua wants to take revenge on Chin-niu for he was not willing to cure her husband which caused his death. She injures Hsiao-fu and the others. But Chin-niu refuses to cure them. Wu-chi helps them but he fails.

Chin-niu has a wife called Nan Ku. He often cured the people who were poisoned by her. She was so angry that she left him. From then on, he decided not to cure the people other than that of Ming Clan.

Having known what Chin Hua has done, Nan Ku goes back to tell her husband. When she knows Chin-niu goes against her, she poisoned herself. Since Chin-niu cannot cure her of the poison, he is willing to die with his wife.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview:
Nan ku is moved and asks Wu-chi to save him. Chin Hua leaves, thinking that they are dead. Chin-niu thanks wu-chi before leaving the valley.

Chin-Hua meets Wu-chi and forces him to become her pupil. Mieh Chueh comes and frightens her away with the Heaven Sword. After Mieh Chueh has found Hsiao-fu, she kills her for she is not willing to kill Yang Chiao.

Wu-chi and Bu-hui go to Kun Lun to find Yang Chiao. On the way, they are saved by Tzu Yuang-tsang of Ming Clan.

Tai-thong wants to kill the doctors for they cannot cure his wife. Wu-chi succeeds in curing her illness.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview:
Tai-chong forces Wu-chi to tell him where Shih-sun is but is in vain. Yang Chiao appears and Wu-chi gives back Bu-hui to him. Wu-chi is bitten by Tzu Chiu-chen's dog and he stays at her home.

Wu-chi loves Chiu-chen but he is always made a scene on by her and Wei Hi, her cousin. Wu-chi knows from Chiu-chen that Tsui-shan has saved the Tzu family. To prevent misunderstandings, Wu-chi does not tell them his true identity.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview:
In fact Tzu Chang-ling has already known Wu-chi's identity. Without knowing that it is a trick for him, Wu-chi tells them where Shih Sun is. But later, he discovers the affairs between Chiu-chen and Wei Hi and understands that it is only a trick. He leaves angrily.

Chang-ling find Wu-chi but they fall down the cliff after a struggle. Wu-chi goes into the Tao Yuan Cave while Chang-ling waits outside. There, Wu-chi discovers a Kung #u book and practices Piercing Sun Skill.

Yu-chun finds Chin-niu and Nan Ku were killed. He reports this to Wu Tang School. They are all worrying about Wu-chi.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview:
Someone kill the martial men but impute it on hung Clan. Mieh Chueh brings Tzu-jo to Wu Tang to convince them and the other clans to exterminate Ming Clan. Having noticed that the six clans are going to attack the Bright Peak, Yang Chiao hurries back.

On the way, he saves Hsiao Chao a girl of Cang who is injured by the Yuan's soldiers. But then Yang Chiao discovers Hsiao Chao knows Kung Flu and so chains her feet.

Wu-chi has learnt the Piercing Sun Skill and forced the poison out of his body. He comes out of the cave and keeps his identity in secret. He meets Yin Li. When Yin Li knows that Chiu-chen has cheated Wu-chi's love, she is so angry that she kills Chiu-chen.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview:
After Yin Li killed Chiu-chen, she is chased. No one can recognize Wu-chi who is forced to agree to marry Yin Li. Mieh Chueh thinks they have something to do with Ming Clan and so captures them.

On the other hand, Yang Chiao asks the four protectors to save Ming Clan together.

Wu-chi is sad for he cannot unite with his uncles. Tzu-jo understands him and pacify him.

Chen You-liang, elder of Beggars Clan gathers the disciples to take advantages on the fight between the six clans and Ming Clan without informing Shi Huo-lung, his Chief.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview:
Mieh Chueh captures the Ming's disciples. Wu-chi is willing to be strike by Mieh Chueh to exchange for the freedom of the disciples. He protects himself with Piercing Sun Style.

Wei Yi-Hsiao brings Yin Li away when Yeh-wang wants to kill her. He wants to blackmail Yin Tien-tseng to deal with the six clans with Yin Li. Hut she is then saved by Chin Hua.

Chin Hua is angry with Yin Li who leaves the island to look for her lover. Yin Li brings Chin Hua to force Wu Lieh to tell them the whereabouts of Shih Sun.

When the Ming's decides to join together, Chen Kun appeared and attacked them suddenly.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview:
Chen Kun tells the Ming brothers his past that his lover was forced to marry Yang Ting-tien, the chief of Ming Clan. Ting-tien died when he discovered they met secretly. Madam Yang killed herself out of shame. Chen Kun swore to exterminate Ming Clan. He used all means to ruin the reputation of Ming Clan.

Wu-chi knows Chen Kun is the enemy of his god-father, and therefore, he chases him. Hut he is kept in a secret passage with Hsiao Chao. There, they find the Kung Fu of Ming Clan. Wu-chi learns it and comes out. However, King Clan is already in a dangerous condition.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview:
Wu-chi tells the clans about the intrigue of Chen Kun. Having heard that Chen Kun has died, Shaolin thinks Wu-chi accuses him falsely. The clans are angry. Kieh Cnueh orders Tzu-jo to kill Wu-chi, Tzu-jo injures him seriously. Wu-chi reveals his identity to his uncle, Li-ting and they save him immediately.

Li-ting wants to kill Yang Chiao to avenge for Hsiao-fu. Hut then Bu-hui says her mother was killed by Mieh Chueh. After the six clans have left, Beggars Clan comes to attack Ming Clan Wu-chi is selected as the Chief to lead and re-organize Ming Clan.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview:
You-liang is discontented for he is punished by Huo-lung.

Wu-chi and Yang Chiao want to go to find Shih Sun. On the way, they find that the people of the six clans are injured by Shaolin's Chin Kang Finger. Injured seriously, Li-ting thinks that Bu-hui is Hsiao-fu. 6u-hui pities him and is willing to take care of him.

On the way Wu-chi goes to Shaolin, he meets Chao Min, a Mongol Princess, who is disguised as a man. Chao Min keeps herself and Wu-chi inside a trap so as to test his Kung Fu. Finally, he can come out but finds the Chiefs of the six clans are caught.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview:
Chao Min sends someone to give wu-chi her hair-pin to show her love to him.

When wu-chi arrives at Shaolin, he finds that someone has ruined the clan in name of Ming Clan. Having noticed that wu Tang is going to be attacked, he hurried to wu Tang.

San-feng who believes that Ming Clan has really ruined Shaolin Temple is injured seriously by Master Kong Hsing. Chao Min arrives and forces wu Tang to yield to the Mongol Empire.  Wu-chi asks Chao Min to give him ointment for Tai-yen and Li-ting. Hut out of jealousy, she refuses and leaves.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview:
Wu-chi looks for Chao Min to beg for the ointment. Hut it is also poisonous. He is willing to die to exchange for the antidote. Chao Min will not give it to him unless he promises to do three things for him. He agrees.

Li-ting and Bu-fu have fallen in love with each other. At last they get married.

Knowing that the Chiefs of the six clans are caught by Chao Min, Wu-chi plans to look for their whereabouts.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview:
In fact, the Chiefs of the six clans are caught by Chao Min. Hut she imputes it on Ming Clan.

On the other hand, after Chen Kun failed in his plan to exterminate Ming Clan, he pretends to have died. Now he goes back to Shaolin to struggle to be the abbot.

The six clans are not willing to yield to the Mongol Empire. Before killing them, Chao Min wants to learn the specialties of their Kung Fu.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview:
Yu-chun, now a leader of a stockade, swears to go against Yuan with Wu-chi. Having got the news from Yuan Tsang, Wu-chi sneaks in Wan An Temple.

Chao Min insults Tai-chong and Tzu-jo. Wu-chi stops her with the present she gave him. out of jealousy, she orders Wu-chi to injure Tzu-jo. But Yu-hsiao stops her in time.

Yi-hsiao and Yang Chiao come across Fan Yao, another advisor of Ming Clan. He deformed his look and be an agent in the house of the lord.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview:
Wu-chi and Fan Yao prepare a trap for the Elders of Mystirs to get the anti-dote to save the hostages. Chao Min is angry for Wu-chi saves Tzu-jo.

Mieh Chueh tells Tzu-jo the secret of the Dragon Sabre and the Heaven Sword. She forces Tzu-jo to swear and tells her to be the Chief of E Mei. She even asks her to seduce Wu-chi so as to get the sword and sabre.

Wan An Temple is set on fire. Wu-chi goes to save them. Hut Mieh Chueh dies in this incident.

Although the lord disallows Chao Min to befriend with Wu-chi, she disobeys her father and goes to find Shih Sun with Wu-chi.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview:
Ching-shu pacifies Tzu-jo but is not appreciated. Yao-liang teaches him to rape her. Out of fright, Ching-sha kills Sheng-ku who discovers his evil-intention. Because Min-chun is discontent with Tzu-jo as the Chief, she accuses her of ganging with Ming Clan.

Chin Hua is disappointed for she cannot contest with Mieh Chueh. She decides to bring Tzu-jo away and with fight with her after she has learnt the Kung Fu of E Mei.

Kong Min and Kong Tsi are surprised to see Chen Kun alive but are deceived again. Chin Hua feels the strength of the Heaven Sword and o, she convinces Shih Sun to give her the sabre in the name of looking for Wu-chi.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview:
At the time Wu-chi and Shih Sun reunite, they are attacked by Ming Clan of Persia. Chao Min saves them and Wu-chi is moved.

Chin Hua is a Persian, she was a beauty when she was young. She married to Han Chian-yeh and was chased by the Persians. She wanted to steal the Heaven and Earth Style of Ming Clan in Chung Yuan but failed.

When Wu-chi wants to help her, she tells them that Hsiao Chao is her daughter. Since her identity is revealed, she will bring her back to Persia.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview:
Hsiao Chao separates with wu-chi unwillingly. When Wu-chi goes back on the island, Tzu-jo and Yin Li are injured while Chao Min has disappeared. Wu-chi thinks it is done by Chao Min and swears to take revenge for Yin Li who dies at last.

Tzu-jo is engaged to Wu-chi so that wu-chi can cure the wound of Tzu-jo.

Chen Kun wants to make Beggars Clan submit to the Empire but he fails. Then he asks Yao-liang to blackmail Ching-shu to help them with the death of Sheng–ku.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview:
In a meeting held by Yao-liang, Chao Min is attacked. Wu-chi saves her. Hence, Yao-liang says that Wu-chi gangs with the Yuans.

Wu-chi is in a dilemma between his feeling to Chao Min and the oath to kill her. Chao Min suggests settling this affair in front of Shih Sun and Tzu-jo. They set off to look for them.

They are led to the corpse of Sheng-ku. Seeing that Wu-chi is carrying the corpse, Yuan-chiao mistakes that he gangs with the Yuans to kill Sheng-ku. Wu-chi is unable to defend himself and brings Chao Min away.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview:
Wu-chi finds that Tzu-jo is caught by Beggars Clan. He blackmails the Chief to release her. Later the disciples discover that their chief was killed. Yao-liang runs away out of fear.

Ching-shu is forced to poison the Wu Tang disciples. Wu-chi tells it to Bu-hui. Ching-shu is so frightened that he does not do it after Bu-hui has revealed it. But their misunderstanding has become even deeper. San-feng promises to find out the truth for Wu-chi.

Later Yuan-chiao discovers the bad deeds of Ching-shu by accident. Wu-chi and Chao Min are found as innocent.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview:
Chao Min leaves Wu-chi for fear that she will involve him. Hut then they meets again. Tzu-jo is stimulated to see them and wants to commit suicide. Wu-chi promises to marry her.

Ching-shu grieves on the marriage of Tzu-jo and Wu-chi. Provoked by Tai-chong, he challenges Wu-chi to fight. Ching-shu refuses to listen to the explanation of Wu-chi. At last Ching-shu is defeated.

Chao Min is so sad that she cannot practise well. At the same time, she is puzzled for her father advises her not to fall in love with the Han.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview:
Shih Sun is accused of killing Kong Chien. He is kept by Chen Kun in Shaolin and is guarded by the three elders. On the wedding, Chao Min stops Wu-Chi and Tzu-jo from getting married and tells Wu-chi about the situation of Shih Sun. Wu-chi leaves with her.

Tzu-jo is so angry that she injured Chao Min and ends the engagement with Wu-chi. Wu-chi wonders why she knows such devilish Kung Fu. After this incident, Tzu-jo becomes a quiet and lonely leader.

In order to kill Shih Sun by the martial man, a Lion Killing Meeting is going to be held by Chen Kun, so that neither Shaolin nor he is responsible.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview:
Although the people are discontented with Wu-chi for he left during the wedding, Chang Song-hsi believes that he has his reason.

Chao Min loves Wu-chi so much that she runs away from home and follows Wu-chi despite of the objection of her father. On the other hand, Tzu-jo rejects the care and love of Ching-shu decisively.

In a temple, Wu-chi and Chao Min discover the monks there are the traitors of shaolin who work for Chen Kun and Yau-Bang. wu-chi pretends to be their gangsters so as to investigate it.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview:
In order to know what it is about the Lion Killing Meeting, wu-chi goes to work in Shaolin. When he wants to save Shih Sun who knows that he is too sinful, wu-chi is forced to leave alone.

Wu-chi tells the three elders about what Chen Kun has done and explains the feud between Shaolin and shih Sun. However, Wu-chi is still unable to bring Shih Sun away.

Knowing the bad deeds of Chen Kun, Kong Min wants to release Shih Sun. To carry on with his plan, chen Kun burns Ta Mo Hall and forces wu-chi to fight with the three elders. Shih Sun blackmails him to leave with death for he's afraid that Wu-chi will be injured.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview:
The people are disappointed for the Dragon Sabre is not in the Temple. So they decide to hold a contest. The winner can fight with the three elders so as to get Shih Sun.

Wu-chi is so sorry that he begs pardon from Tzu-jo. He is shocked to know that she has married to Ching-shu. Knowing that Ching-shu has betrayed Wu Tang because of love, Yuan-chiao ends the relationship with him.

In the fight, Ching-shu is injured seriously by Wu Tang; and Tzu-jo becomes the winner who can contest with the three elders.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview:
Hoping that Tzu-jo will be moved and will save Shih Sun with him, he cure Ching-shu of his wound. Hut Tzu-jo does not have any concern for him at all.

When Tzu-jo fights with the three elders, she insults wu-chi and asks him to join hands with her. In order to save his god-father, wu-chi tolerates the insult; at last, he succeeds to save Shih Sun.

Chen Kun insists to fight with Shih Sun. In the fight, Shih Sun blinds Chen Kun's eyes and then abolish his own Kung Fu which is taught by Chen Kun. Realizing that he is sinful, Shih Sun stays in Shaolin for the rest of his life.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview:
Shih Sun gives a hint to Wu-chi that the one who killed Yin Liis Tzu-jo, Wu-chi is so shocked that he asks Tzu-jo who admits it frankly. In fact she took away the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, poisoned and killed Yin-li, forced Chao Min to go away and imputed the blames on Chao Min.

Thinking that Wu-chi still loves her, Tzu-jo forces him to choose one between herself and Chao Min. After a struggle within himself, Wu-chi declares his love to Chao Min.

Chen Kun tells the Yuans to attack the Shaolin Temple. Wu-chi is recommended by the six clans to be the leader to fight against the Yuans.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview:
Suspecting that Chao Min has some evil intention, the six clans catch Chao Min and blackmail the lord to retreat. On the other hand, the lord ends the relationship with her for he thinks that she has ganged with the Hans.

Because Tzu-jo feels shameful for what she has done, she tells Wu-chi the secrets of the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre. Finally, he is able to defeat the Yuans.

Tzu-jo decides to leave Wu-chi from now on. Hut the six clans still think that Chao Min will affect the reputation of King Clan. Thus, Chao Min leaves Wu-chi without a word. In front of Wu-chi, there are reputation and love. What is Wu-chi going to do? ...........
